arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: A delivery from Serene? I swear she thinks I live on bread and stubbornness.

arrival.speaker: elira
arrival.text: Good. There's a lantern up there, if you'd be kind enough.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Is this the one for your husband?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: It is. He used to say he'd only come to hear me sing. The old liar couldn't carry a tune himself.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Does preparing it make you sad?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Some days. But remembering him isn't the same as losing him again.

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: You will come to the festival, won't you?

resolution.speaker: elira
resolution.text: Good. Tell Serene I'll bring the lantern myself.

reminder.speaker: elira
reminder.text: The stool is just beneath the shelf. Take your time with the lantern.

carrying.speaker: elira
carrying.text: You can set it on the table. Thank you for fetching it.

after.speaker: elira
after.text: I'll bring the lantern myself. Thank Serene for me, won't you?
